close_reason: Fixed in commit. Restructured destroy loop to validate-and-collect in one pass: walk destroy_arr once, push to Vec<String> on Some(s), return invalidArguments on None. title: handle_metadata_set destroy loop carries an unreachable 'None => continue' arm after find() validation
